title: NODE — The Road That Hasn't Existed for Twenty Years

features.name: a street directory, unfolded
features.desc-on-touch: Service station maps opened to twenty times the size of the windscreen. Given the objectively real turnoff or the road on the map, they always followed the map.

features.name: a payphone in a two pub town
features.desc-on-touch: She photographed it. He memorised the ten digits stamped on its side. The next district over, a phone system answered her completely, like finding money in a coat pocket.

features.name: an honour shield of duxes and sporting heroes
features.desc-on-touch: Bulletin boards in bakeries, racing guides, menus written in hand, hotel guest books, radio logs. All read. All eligible.

features.name: a handshake, falling apart
features.desc-on-touch: Sometimes she reached what sounded like a modem, but it fell apart like a desiccation of insect wing scatter.

file.name: Payphone_TenDigits.txt
file.note: Memorised, never written. The archive has it anyway.
